reviewed_exact_row: 30002112 / OWR-12005-004: dimension-only additive boundary-Laplacian estimate λk(∂Ω)|∂Ω|^(2/m)≤Am I(Ω)^(1+2/m)+Bm k^(2/m). Original Colbois OWR 33/2012 pp.2034–2036: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46403

Isoperimetric inequalities for Laplace and Steklov problems on Riemannian manifolds — Luc Pétiard; Université de Neuchâtel doctoral thesis, 2019; defended 5 February 2019, imprimatur 5 March 2019. Prior full negative answer: Theorem 2.1.2 p.24/PDF36 produces, for every m≥2 and any prescribed asymptotic coefficient, arbitrarily large-index normalized boundary eigenvalues with bounded isoperimetric ratio, even with connected boundary. Choosing the index after the ratio bound defeats any proposed additive dimension constants, including the original I^(1+2/m) variant. DOI resolves exact institutional thesis; Crossref registration verified (DataCite 404 was a wrong-registry query). 2025 repository accession is not thesis date. Existing publication; audit: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1142
